About.title: A rental agency that answers at midnight
About.lead: ABC Rent a Car is a small agency from Sarajevo. We bring the car where you need it and pick up the phone even in the middle of the night.
About.intro2: Our fleet has city cars, SUVs, the Mercedes E-Class and vans for nine people. Every car has an automatic gearbox.
About.storyP1: We bring the car to wherever you need it: Sarajevo Airport or any address in Sarajevo, at no extra cost. Every vehicle is fully insured and regularly serviced.
About.storyP2: Besides car rental we offer a professional chauffeur service and airport transfers. You can book through the website, WhatsApp or by phone.

Requirements.title: What you need
Requirements.lead: Four things and the car is yours. If anything is unclear, ask us before you book and we will gladly explain.

items.title: Driving licence
items.body: Valid, in the name of the driver picking up the car.

items.title: ID card or passport
items.body: One of the two, together with your driving licence.

items.title: Card for the deposit
items.body: Credit or debit. The deposit is {standard} €, or {premium} € for the Audi Q7 and Mercedes E Class.

items.title: No payment to book
items.body: You pay nothing in advance. Cancellation is free up to 24 hours before pick-up.

Requirements.footer: The deposit is returned as soon as the car is back in good shape.

Destinations.title: Where to this weekend?
Destinations.lead: Places our guests visit most often. Times are approximate and depend on the road and the season.
Destinations.ask: Not sure which car to take? Message us and we will suggest a car and a route.
Destinations.waPrefix: Hi, I'm planning a trip to:

items.name: Jahorina
items.note: The Olympic mountain. Skiing in winter, hiking and bike trails in summer.

items.name: Bjelašnica
items.note: Ski slopes and the road to Lukomir, the highest village in Bosnia.

items.name: Konjic
items.note: Rafting on the Neretva and an old stone bridge in the town centre.

items.name: Mostar
items.note: The Old Bridge and the bazaar, with Jablanica lake on the way.

items.name: Kravice
items.note: Waterfalls on the Trebižat river. You can swim there in summer.

items.name: Jajce
items.note: The Pliva waterfall right in town and the old watermills on the lake.
